cases.name: empty, leaf and node hashes preserve byte domains and child order
cases.scope: Literal empty root, empty leaf, independent node preimage, raw-versus-UTF8-hex, leaf/node domains and child order.

cases.name: ports eight leaf inputs and all nine known roots from constants.go
cases.scope: Exactly eight upstream raw leaf inputs and nine published roots at sizes 0 through 8.

cases.name: ports the five exact happy-path inclusion JSON vectors
cases.scope: Exactly five inclusion happy-path JSON objects; literal roots/leaves/proofs constrain generators and verifier.

cases.name: ports the five exact happy-path consistency JSON vectors
cases.scope: Exactly five consistency happy-path JSON objects; literal roots/proofs constrain generators and verifier.

cases.name: matches an independent recursive root at every size from 1 through 64
cases.scope: Independent naive node:crypto roots for every synthetic 32-byte input prefix, sizes 1 through 64.

cases.name: verifies every inclusion index against independent roots for sizes 1 through 64
cases.scope: Every index for sizes 1 through 64; 2,080 data rows in one fixed test body.

cases.name: verifies every consistency pair through size 64 against independent roots
cases.scope: Every oldSize 0 through newSize for newSize 1 through 64; 2,144 data rows in one fixed test body.

cases.name: incremental and rebuilt frontiers match independent RFC roots through size 64
cases.scope: Incremental/rebuilt RFC frontiers at sizes 0 through 64, compared to independent roots and valid shape.

cases.name: refuses the exact size-2 inclusion witness when only declared size changes to 3
cases.scope: Positive index0/size2 proof followed by identical leaf/proof/root with declared size3, verifier refusal first.

cases.name: rejects malformed, changed, extra, missing and wrong-index inclusion inputs
cases.scope: Positive inclusion followed by tampered siblings/leaf/root, extra/missing path, concrete wrong index, malformed hashes and invalid numeric bounds.

cases.name: rejects malformed consistency proofs, changed roots, invalid sizes and boundary mismatches
cases.scope: Positive consistency followed by tampered siblings/roots, extra/missing path, malformed hashes/numeric bounds, equal-root and empty-extension boundaries; no arbitrary 0/0 canonical-root rule.

cases.name: legacy three/four roots collide while RFC roots differ and both proof APIs remain usable
cases.scope: Actual algorithm-aware root/proof helpers demonstrate legacy 3/4 collision, RFC inequality, both valid RFC proofs and cross-tree refusal.

cases.name: RFC entry verification needs index and size and derives sides rather than trusting flags
cases.scope: RFC wrapper positive then missing index/size and malformed entry refusal; reverse display flags preserve validity because sides derive from index/size.

M1.description: Unchanged literal empty-root positive precedes literal empty-input leaf assertion. Other actual failures and masks remain unobserved.

M2.description: Standalone verifier refusal follows actual generated proof shape and valid size2 positive. No direct inclusionSides assertion can mask it.

excluded: Stricter canonical empty-root rejection for arbitrary equal roots at 0/0
Rekor/SCITT/public submission or offline receipt integration
Library adoption, release, full issue, full suite, coverage or quality closure
